what.text: This page follows refugees from Ethiopia living in the United Kingdom, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4505 Ethiopian refugees in the United Kingdom, 2.7% of all refugees from Ethiopia.
Sudan hosts the most Ethiopian refugees, followed by Kenya, Uganda and South Africa.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflicts over Oromiya and Ogaden territory in Ethiopia in periods from 1983.
It also records interstate armed conflicts between Eritrea and Ethiopia from 1998 to 2000 and in 2016.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1988 at 909 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 5100, at the end of 2001.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1992 to 2002, 2005 to 2009 and 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United Kingdom.
These are year-end totals for the United Kingdom only, reported to UNHCR.
